description: Envoy front door that routes every web request to the frontend, images and feature flags.
Next.js web frontend that renders the shop pages and serves its API routes.
Product catalogue service that lists products and their prices.
Cart service that stores each visitor's shopping cart.
Valkey cache that holds the shopping carts.
Checkout service that places an order: cart, prices, payment, shipping and confirmation.
Payment service that charges the customer's card.
Currency service that converts prices between currencies.
Shipping service that quotes shipping costs and ships orders.
Quote service that computes shipping cost quotes.
Email service that sends the order confirmation.
Recommendation service that suggests related products.
Ad service that serves contextual ads.
nginx server for the product images.
flagd feature flag service that evaluates flags for every service.
Web console for editing feature flags.
Kafka message queue that carries placed orders to accounting and fraud detection.
PostgreSQL database that holds the product catalogue and the accounting ledger.
Accounting service that records each placed order in the ledger.
Fraud detection service that screens each placed order.
